answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 75 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a prism bet on surviving 75 epochs of grading, and every meadow settlement recomputes the voyage schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
